subject: Pilot pricing addendum — short burst top-up vs seat-credit option
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@bluebridge.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot — short extension/options request

Hi Avery / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our data-science team pushed a set of heavier inference tests and we’re nearly at the end of our two-week pilot. Before we shut things down, we want to explore a very short extension (10–14 days) focused on burst throughput for a new workload.

Two quick asks:
- Can you send a short pricing note for a 10-day top-up (burst credits) vs. the alternative of adding 1–2 temporary seats for the pilot?
- If we take the top-up route, what does the procurement flow look like from our side (we usually need a PO)?

We’re under time pressure to finish the evaluation this month; a tight turnaround would be helpful.

Laura
Laura Chen
Director, ML Engineering
Bluebridge Health

Attachments: none

From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@bluebridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot — short extension/options request

Hi Laura — thanks for the note. Short answer: we can do both, and I attached a one-page addendum you can share with procurement. High-level options below (all prices are USD and assume current pilot model + standard support):

Option A — Burst credit top-up (recommended for short bursts):
- 10-day pack: 250k token credits, non-refundable, usable within 14 days
- Upfront: $4,500
- No changes to seats or licensing; engineering access unchanged

Option B — Temporary seat add (best if you need concurrent engineers + separate quotas):
- 2 temporary seats for 14 days: $3,600 (seat-based rate, per-seat)
- Requires short addendum to license; seats expire after 14 days

Operational notes:
- If you need a PO, use the attached addendum (pilot-addendum-draft.pdf) and we’ll route an invoice once procurement confirms the option.
- If you want us to accelerate procurement-side paperwork, Marissa can pick up with your PO contact — she’s CC’d.

Next step: which option feels better for the test? If you confirm, I’ll kick off finance and send an invoice estimate.

— Avery
Avery Johnson
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachment: pilot-addendum-draft.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@bluebridge.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 11:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot — short extension/options request

Laura — quick pricing clarifications from my side (finance checks):

- We can offer a 10% pilot partner discount on Option A for first-time customers (applies to the 10-day pack only). That would bring the 10-day pack to $4,050.
- Option B (temporary seats) is usually not discounted below the seat rate for very short windows because seat entitlement and license cleanup create downstream cost for us, but we can do a 5% courtesy for 14-day adds if you prefer that route.

Procurement flow:
1) You confirm option.
2) We generate an addendum + invoice estimate (I’ll include net-30 terms unless procurement requests otherwise).
3) Your procurement sends PO — we accept and schedule the credit/seat activation immediately after PO receipt.

Karthik — can you confirm we can expedite activation within 24 hours of PO?

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-minute call if you want to walk the tradeoffs.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@bluebridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@bluebridge.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 14:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot — short extension/options request

Thanks — that’s helpful and fast, much appreciated.

We’ll take Option A with the 10% pilot discount (so $4,050). Procurement is cc’d on this thread — hi PO team, can you confirm if Bluebridge needs an initial quote or if our internal approval + PO will be sufficient? If you need a formal quote, Marissa / Avery, please send and we’ll route a PO ASAP.

If procurement confirms we can proceed via PO, can you provision the credits within 24 hours of the PO? We’d like to start testing tonight if possible.

Laura
